Delhi Police arrests 6 linked to Pakistan gangster's terror network

Delhi Police's Special Cell arrested six individuals linked to the Shahzad Bhatti network. The arrests were made from Delhi and Punjab, uncovering two separate modules. Recovered items include petrol bombs and pistols. The network is described by some outlets as Pakistan-backed and linked to an ISI agent.
